summary: Frontend-only Playwright test of new HR Employee module features (Application Reference, Photo+Signature, Structured addresses, IFSC auto-fetch, Documents upload, Print A4 Portrait) and 2 regression bugs from iteration 21. RESULTS: 8 of 10 features PASS. All data-testids present. Applied Post dropdown (19 options incl. Manager/Site Incharge/Engineer/Mason/Helper/Peon/Cashier). State dropdown with 36 Indian states+UTs. IFSC 'SBIN0001234' auto-fills Bank='State Bank of India' with ✓ status within ~2s via Razorpay API. Same-as-Present checkbox disables permanent address fields. Print popup opens with 'EMPLOYEE APPLICATION FORM' title, Advertisement/Project refs, candidate name, HR Workflow footer. FAILURES: (1) HIGH — hr-emp-approve NOT disabled for User role (same bug as iteration 21, NOT fixed — is_disabled=False, cursor=pointer, bg=red #dc2626, opacity=1). (2) MEDIUM — Permanent EMP code format wrong: generated 'AE/EMP/000025/2627' but spec says 'AE/EMP/000006/25-26' (missing hyphen between start/end FY years). PASS: Previous ExitTab bug IS FIXED — Exit tab no longer early-returns, form + table render when no active employees.

ui_bugs.issue: `hr-emp-approve` NOT disabled for User role (test.user@arun.com). is_disabled()=False, disabled attr=null, bg=rgb(220,38,38) red, cursor=pointer, opacity=1. Spec required disabled styling. This is the SAME bug reported in iteration_21 and remains unfixed. Likely cause: user has `permissions.approve===true` override in auth profile, OR canApprove() in store.js is being resolved truthy due to _myPerms() override. Check if seeding/admin console has given test.user approve rights accidentally. Verify by inspecting localStorage ae_vm_auth.permissions for test.user.

Permanent EMP code generated as 'AE/EMP/000025/2627' but task spec requires 'AE/EMP/000006/25-26' (hyphen between the two FY years). Current getFY() returns 4 concatenated digits ('2627'). Needs to format as `${startYY}-${endYY}` for EMP code (or change getFY globally — but that would affect other IDs like BILL/JV/BOQ). Recommended: create dedicated getFYHyphen() helper and use in buildEmpCode only.

action_items: FIX HIGH: Disable hr-emp-approve button for User role. Check why canApprove() returns true for 'User'. Likely a per-user permission override in auth profile — grep for places that set permissions.approve. Alternative: explicitly check `['SuperAdmin','Admin'].includes(currentRole())` in HRManagement.jsx L190 as a role-based guard regardless of _myPerms() override, since Final Approve is a role-sensitive action.

FIX MEDIUM: Change buildEmpCode in /app/frontend/src/lib/store.js L900 so FY uses hyphenated format `25-26`. Add helper `const getFYHy = () => { const f = getFY(); return `${f.slice(0,2)}-${f.slice(2,4)}`; };` and use it only in buildEmpCode to avoid breaking other IDs.
critical_code_review_comments: HRManagement.jsx L190: disabled={!approveAllowed || Number(emp.step) >= 5} — logic is correct in principle, but approveAllowed=canApprove() receives true for User role in practice. Investigate root: `_myPerms()` likely returns `{approve:true}` for test.user. Needs either role gate or clearing stale permission override.
store.js L48 getFY: returns '2627' concat format which doesn't match the task spec '25-26' hyphenated format for EMP code. Consider separate FY formatter per use case.
HRManagement.jsx L972 ExitTab: now correctly keeps history rendered — bug fix verified.

HRManagement.jsx EmployeeEditor at L86 is 395 lines long inside a 1208-line file — consider extracting sections (Application Reference / Personal / Contact / Documents) into separate sub-components for maintainability.
store.js at 1339 lines exceeds 700-line guideline — split into hrStore.js / vendorStore.js / expenseStore.js etc.

rca of the issue: RCA #1 (approve btn): canApprove() in store.js L879 first checks _myPerms() override. If test.user's auth profile has permissions.approve===true (possibly set by SuperAdmin accidentally in admin console), canApprove returns true even though role='User'. Recommended fix: hard-code role check `const r = currentRole(); if (!['SuperAdmin','Admin'].includes(r)) return false;` BEFORE honoring _myPerms override for approve. Alternative: inspect localStorage ae_vm_auth after User login to confirm permissions.approve setting. RCA #2 (EMP code FY): buildEmpCode uses getFY() which returns '2627' (concat start+end 2-digit years without separator). Task spec needs '25-26' hyphenated. Simple fix in buildEmpCode L900: `const f=getFY(); const fyHy=`${f.slice(0,2)}-${f.slice(2,4)}`; return `AE/EMP/${pad6(serial)}/${fyHy}`;`
